completeProfile.q: How do I complete my profile?
completeProfile.a: Open Profile → My Information and fill in your name, categories, location and bio. The progress bar on the profile page tells you what's left.

campaignsWork.a: Browse open campaigns from the Campaigns tab, apply with a short pitch, and once a brand approves you, post the deliverables and link them inside the campaign detail page.

dealsRequirement.q: What's the requirement to receive deals?
dealsRequirement.a: A connected Instagram (Business / Creator account), a published media kit, and a rate card. The profile completion checklist shows you exactly what's pending.

refreshStats.q: How do I refresh my Instagram stats?
refreshStats.a: Profile → tap the Instagram card → Refresh. Stats sync at most once per hour to stay within Instagram's API limits.

reconnect.a: Instagram access tokens expire every 60 days. Opening Profile while signed in usually auto-renews the token; if it's already expired, you'll see a Reconnect button.

reelsMissing.a: Reels only sync from Business / Creator accounts. Switch in the Instagram app under Settings → Account type, then come back and tap Refresh on your Profile.

whenPaid.a: Once the brand approves your live links, payment moves to Payment Released. Funds typically reflect within 7–10 business days.

addPayment.q: How do I add a UPI ID or bank account?
addPayment.a: Profile → Payment Methods → Add New. The first method you add becomes your primary payout destination.

paymentMissing.a: If the campaign is on Payment Released for more than 14 business days, tap Request a callback in support — we'll chase the brand.

customQuote.q: How does Get Custom Quote work?
customQuote.a: Pick a service, submit the brief, and the seller replies with a quote. Once you accept and pay the advance via Stripe, work begins.

trackOrders.q: Where do I track my orders?
trackOrders.a: Profile → Service Requests. Each order has its own page with status and payment breakdown.

revision.a: Yes. While the draft is in review, open the order and tap Request Revision. You'll be asked to describe what to change.

takeBreak.q: How do I take a break without losing my data?
takeBreak.a: Profile → Privacy & Security → Deactivate Account. Your data is preserved; signing in with the same phone reactivates everything.

removeDevice.q: How do I remove a device that's logged in?
removeDevice.a: Profile → Privacy & Security → Trusted Devices. Tap Remove on any device that isn't yours.

notificationPrefs.a: Profile → Notifications. Toggles persist immediately and the disabled categories stop appearing in your bell and on the notifications page.

campaign_apply_how.label: How do I apply to a campaign?
campaign_apply_how.response: Browse open campaigns from the Campaigns tab, open one you like, and tap Apply. Brands review applications within a few days.

campaign_missing.label: I can't find a campaign I applied to
campaign_missing.response: Open Campaigns and switch to the Applied tab — that's where every active application lives. The Completed tab only shows wrapped-up campaigns.

campaign_submit.label: How do I submit deliverables / live links?
campaign_submit.response: Open the campaign detail page; once your application is Approved you'll see a Submit Deliverables button. After the live post goes up, paste the Instagram link there.

profile_ig.label: Update / refresh my Instagram
profile_ig.response: Open your Profile, tap the Instagram card, and use Refresh to pull the latest stats. If your token has expired you'll see a reconnect button there.

profile_photo.label: Change profile photo
profile_photo.response: Profile → tap your avatar → upload a new image. We'll auto-crop it to a clean circle.

profile_bio.label: Edit bio, categories or location
profile_bio.response: Profile → My Information lets you edit name, bio, categories and city. Brands use these to match you to campaigns.

profile_reels.label: My reels aren't showing
profile_reels.response: Reels sync from your linked Instagram. Profile → Refresh Instagram pulls the latest. If they still don't appear, your IG account may not be a Business/Creator profile.

service_browse.label: How do I browse services?
service_browse.response: Open the Services tab to see everything I offer to brands — reels, photo shoots, story takeovers, ambassadorships, and more. Each card opens a detail page with my rates and turnaround.

service_quote.label: How does Custom Quote work?
service_quote.response: Pick a service, tap Get Custom Quote, fill in what you need and submit. I review and reply with a personalised quote — once you accept, you pay the advance via Stripe and we move into delivery.

service_order_track.label: Track an existing order
service_order_track.response: Profile → Orders shows every service request you've made. Each order page has the live status, payment breakdown, and any draft deliverables ready for review.

service_payment.label: Payment / advance not going through
service_payment.response: Stripe occasionally declines cards on first attempt — try once more, or use a different card / UPI. If it still fails, request a callback and we'll help you wrap it up.

service_revision.label: Request a revision on a draft
service_revision.response: Open the order from Profile → Orders. While the draft is in review you'll see a Request Revision button — describe what to change and I'll re-deliver.

service_callback.label: Talk to a human about a service

pay_when.label: When do I get paid?
pay_when.response: Once the brand approves your live links, the payment moves to Payment Released. Funds typically reflect in your account within 7–10 business days.

pay_late.label: Payment hasn't arrived
pay_late.response: Check the campaign detail page — if it's still on Payment Released after 14 business days, request a callback and we'll chase the brand for you.

pay_bank.label: Add or update bank details
pay_bank.response: Profile → Payment Methods. We use these only for releasing your campaign earnings.

plans_upgrade.label: Upgrade my plan
plans_upgrade.response: Pick the plan that fits — Pro unlocks 15 applications/month and richer analytics, Elite is unlimited.

plans_compare.label: What's the difference between plans?
plans_compare.response: Open the pricing page for the full feature matrix — applications/month, analytics depth, audience demographics, deal matching priority and support level.

plans_cancel.label: Cancel my subscription
plans_cancel.response: Subscriptions can be cancelled directly from Stripe's billing portal. If you can't access it, request a callback and we'll cancel it for you.

tech_slow.label: App is slow or won't load
tech_slow.response: Force-close the app and reopen it. If it persists, log out and back in. Still broken? Request a callback with what you were doing when it happened.

tech_login.label: Can't sign in
tech_login.response: Use the same Instagram account you signed up with. If OTP isn't arriving, double-check the country code — we send to +91 numbers only right now.

tech_ig_token.label: Instagram says reconnect
tech_ig_token.response: IG tokens expire every 60 days. Profile → Reconnect Instagram refreshes it without losing any data.

issue_no_response.label: Brand hasn't responded
issue_no_response.responsePending: Your application is still Pending with {{brand}}. If it's been over 5–7 days since you applied, request a callback and we'll nudge them.
issue_no_response.responseOther: Your application status is "{{status}}". If you're waiting on something specific, request a callback so we can chase {{brand}} for you.

issue_payment.label: Payment is delayed
issue_payment.responseCompleted: {{brand}} has marked this campaign Completed. Payment usually reflects within 7–10 business days. If 14+ business days have passed, request a callback.
issue_payment.responsePayment: {{brand}} has released payment. It typically takes 7–10 business days to land. If it's been longer, request a callback.
issue_payment.responseOther: Payments only release after the brand approves your live links. Current status: "{{status}}". Once it moves to Payment, the 7–10 day clock starts.

issue_deliverables.label: Submit / update deliverables
issue_deliverables.responseApproved: Open the campaign detail page — you'll see a Submit Deliverables button now that {{brand}} has approved you.
issue_deliverables.responseRevision: {{brand}} has asked for a revision. Open the campaign detail page to see exactly which deliverables need re-uploading.
issue_deliverables.responseAccepted: Now's the time to post the live content and paste the live links inside the campaign detail page.
issue_deliverables.responseOther: Deliverables can only be submitted from the Approved or Accepted state. Your current status is "{{status}}".

issue_rejected.label: Why was I rejected / removed?
issue_rejected.responseRejected: {{brand}} declined your application — usually for fit, timing, or audience match. The campaign goes back to Active so you can apply to a different one. Your monthly application cap isn't impacted.
issue_rejected.responseOther: Your application status is "{{status}}", not rejected. Take another look at the campaign detail page to see the latest update from {{brand}}.

responses.pay_escrow_how: Once a creator accepts your offer, you fund the agreed amount into escrow via Razorpay. We hold it safely while the creator delivers; it's only released to them after you approve the live post. If things fall through, the escrow can be resolved via support.
responses.pay_fund_fail: Razorpay occasionally declines on the first attempt — retry once, or switch card / UPI / netbanking. Make sure you're signed in to the app (an expired session causes a silent failure). Still stuck? Request a callback and we'll complete it with you.
responses.pay_release_how: Open the campaign, review the creator's live links, and approve them — approval moves the escrow to Payment Released and the creator gets paid. You'll find every application on the campaign detail page.
responses.pay_refund: Escrowed funds for work that never happened are refundable. Refunds are handled by our team case-by-case — request a callback with the campaign name and we'll process it.
responses.acct_gstin: Open your brand profile and edit the Business Details section to add or correct your GSTIN. It appears on invoices, so double-check the 15-character format.
responses.acct_verify: Your verification badge and trust score live on your brand profile. Verification usually completes within 1–2 business days of submitting your business details; the trust score grows as you complete campaigns.
responses.acct_edit: Everything — logo, description, website, contact details — is editable from your brand profile page. Creators see this profile when they consider your campaigns, so keep it fresh.

issues.noAppsDraft: This campaign is still a Draft — creators can't see it yet. Publish it from the campaign page to start receiving applications.
issues.noAppsPaused: This campaign is Paused, so it's hidden from creators. Resume it to start receiving applications again.
issues.noAppsCompleted: This campaign is marked Completed, so it no longer accepts applications.
issues.noAppsOther: Matching creators were notified when you published. Check that your categories, follower range and cities aren't too narrow, and that the application deadline hasn't passed — widening them reaches more creators.
issues.reviewZero: No one has applied yet — once creators apply, each application appears on the campaign detail page with the creator's profile, rates and pitch.
issues.reviewSome_one: You have {{count}} application waiting. Open the campaign detail page to review the creator's profile and pitch, then use Approve with Price to send your offer.
issues.reviewSome_other: You have {{count}} applications waiting. Open the campaign detail page to review each creator's profile and pitch, then use Approve with Price to send offers.
issues.deliverables: Creators can submit deliverables only after you approve their application and fund the escrow. If an approved creator is late, open the campaign to check their application status — a friendly nudge usually works. If they've gone quiet for 5+ days, request a callback and we'll follow up.
issues.escrow: After a creator accepts your offer, you pay the agreed amount into escrow via Razorpay from this campaign's page. We hold the funds while the creator delivers, and release them only after you approve the live post — you never pay for work you haven't seen.
issues.release: Payment releases when you approve the creator's live links on the campaign page. If the Release button isn't working or the status looks stuck, note the creator's name and request a callback — we'll resolve the escrow manually.

deleteInfo.heading: This is a soft delete with a 30-day grace window.

deleteInfo.point2: Sign-in is blocked while the account is pending deletion.
deleteInfo.point3: Email grievance@rgossips.com within 30 days if you want it restored.
deleteInfo.point4: After 30 days, the account, campaigns, applications and contact details are permanently removed.
